_help: Side quests on workshop.html. After editing, run: python scripts/build-side-quests.py. Fields: id (lowercase-hyphenated, the card's #anchor), name, language, status (short tag), summary (one sentence), chips (label, plus "backend": true for a teal shadow), repo (GitHub URL, or null to show 'Repo coming soon'). Cards render in this order.

quests.name: Network Capture Inspector
quests.summary: Chrome extension that records a tab's network requests and reviews them for security, performance and client context.

quests.name: Dot Snake
quests.summary: Snake on a dot grid in one HTML file: no build step, light and dark themes, keyboard and touch, and a secret code.

quests.name: Tales Beyond the Frame
quests.summary: Pipeline that turns bilingual stories into narrated, illustrated YouTube videos.
